# netapp-storagegrid_grid_info (Data Source)

Gathers information about the configuration of the grid, with the Grid Management API. It is the equivalent of the module `na_sg_grid_info` of the Ansible collection `netapp.storagegrid`.

The information of each subset is returned as JSON, in `info`, with the name of the subset as the key: use `jsondecode` to read it. It is the `data` of the response of StorageGRID, whose shape depends on the subset and on the release of StorageGRID. The values of the keys whose name contains `password`, `passphrase`, `secret`, `token`, `privateKey`, `credential` or `community` are replaced by `********`.

A subset is read with a single request: StorageGRID may split a long list in pages, use `parameters` (`limit`, `marker`) to control that, and the data sources `netapp-storagegrid_grid_account` and `netapp-storagegrid_grid_accounts` to read the tenant accounts. The subsets that use the private API of StorageGRID are not documented by NetApp, and can change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Some subsets of the information of the grid.
# A subset is the name of a REST API, or the info name that the Ansible module na_sg_grid_info uses.
data "netapp-storagegrid_grid_info" "grid" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "grid1"
  gather_subset = [
    "grid/config/product-version",
    "grid_dns_servers_info",
    "grid/regions",
  ]
}

# The information of a subset is JSON.
output "storagegrid_version" {
  value = jsondecode(data.netapp-storagegrid_grid_info.grid.info["grid/config/product-version"]).productVersion
}

output "dns_servers" {
  value = jsondecode(data.netapp-storagegrid_grid_info.grid.info["grid/dns-servers"])
}

# All the subsets, when there is no gather_subset. The ones that the user may not read are skipped, with a warning.
data "netapp-storagegrid_grid_info" "everything" {
  cx_profile_name = "grid1"
}

# Query parameters are added to the request of each subset: 5 tenant accounts at most.
data "netapp-storagegrid_grid_info" "five_accounts" {
  cx_profile_name = "grid1"
  gather_subset   = ["grid/accounts"]
  parameters = {
    limit = "5"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name. The profile must be a grid profile, without `account_id`.

### Optional

- `gather_subset` (Set of String) The subsets to gather: the name of a subset, as `grid/accounts`, or its info name, as `grid_accounts_info`, or `all` for all the subsets. Defaults to `all`, which sends more than 50 requests. With `all`, a subset that the user is not allowed to read, or that this release of StorageGRID does not have, is skipped with a warning. A subset that is asked for by its name must be read.
- `parameters` (Map of String) Query parameters that are added to the request of each subset, for instance `limit` to limit the number of objects of the lists.

### Read-Only

- `info` (Map of String) The information, as JSON, by name of subset.
